test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

INDULGENCE
solution: The correct answer is '**leniency**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Indulgence**' is '**Leniency**'. • **Indulgence**: the state of having or doing whatever you want; the state or attitude of being indulgent or tolerant. (इच्‍छापूर्ति में संलिप्‍तता; भोगी या सहिष्णु होने की अवस्था या भाव) • *Example: She found that she couldn't afford the **indulgences** she had once enjoyed.* • **Leniency**: the fact or quality of being more merciful or tolerant than expected; clemency. (अपेक्षा से अधिक दयालु या सहिष्णु होने का तथ्य या गुण; दया) • *Example: The court could show **leniency**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Leniency.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:- • **Diligence**: the quality of doing work carefully and thoroughly. (परिश्रम, कर्मठता) • **Accuracy**: the quality or state of being correct or precise. (विशुद्घता, यथार्थता) • **Attentiveness**: the action of paying close attention to something. (किसी चीज पर पूरा ध्यान देने की क्रिया) 3b:Ta9a, The correct answer is '**outhority**'.
